exclusions.trade_selection: BTC-only exploration sampler; other tickers screened by turnover for research priority only.

checkpoint_provenance.migration_basis: Owner selected chat-led simulation with GitHub persistence. Explicitly recover the latest retained 500-USDT account checkpoint; both later journal records contain zero fills. This is a documented journal migration, not a claim that a local runtime is deployed or monitored.

decisions.rationale: No approved CORE model is available. The owner-required activity fallback selects the existing BTC spot ATR14 exploration sampler. Fresh top-ask depth and confirmed hourly candles passed validation; quantity preserves 0.50-0.51% planned NAV stop risk including modeled costs and at least 2R net target. This entry tests execution and forward outcomes; it does not assert a predictive edge.
decisions.alternative_rejected: Inventing balances, stale-price fills, or continuous protection.
decisions.invalidation: At a subsequent actual observation, apply the recorded stop or target against the executable bid with modeled exit costs. Intervening trigger times and continuous protection are unobserved.
decisions.uncertainty: No proven alpha; paper execution assumes displayed top-book depth is available and uses modeled fees. Gap losses may exceed planned stop risk.

review.causality: No attribution of profitability to a single round; open positions have pending outcomes.
review.finding: Prior round had zero fills because account continuity and market freshness were unresolved. Recovered and exactly replayed the retained account history, preserving 499.986797971 USDT and cumulative -0.013202029 USDT realized net PnL. This round obtained fresh complete returned-ticker coverage and one new exploration entry. New position outcome remains pending.
review.current_round_cost_effect: Entry fee plus observed bid/ask spread explain the initial marked loss; no exit or profit is yet realized.

improvement.hypothesis: Verified checkpoint recovery and direct concurrent public API collection can remove the prior account and stale-data blockers while preserving capital and risk settings.
improvement.activity: Validated artifact archive digest, manifest, SQLite integrity, audit chain, all payload hashes and exactly replayed all 16 historical fills. Retrieved the full public spot ticker response and BTC candles; refreshed admission-sensitive instrument metadata and book immediately before execution.

forward_experiment.hypothesis: Track whether gross forward outcomes cover modeled round-trip trading costs under the unchanged BTC sampler.
forward_experiment.evaluation_criterion: Compare realized gross and net PnL, maximum observed adverse movement and execution costs across closed forward trades; one outcome does not validate profitability.

improvement.rollback_condition: Any audit mismatch or data freshness failure blocks admission; append corrections and preserve the existing account.
